notes.title: Upcoming Roadmap & Battle Features
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and thank you as always for playing VTBattle!


We'd like to share an update regarding the upcoming battle features.
Unfortunately, the development has been delayed slightly from the original August release, and we are now aiming for early September.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/456b360ef5b44edb82c1ab27adf5b9475de85f32.png

As a result, the release of Card Pack Vol.9: "Omochi Chronicle" will also be pushed back from early September to mid-September.

We sincerely apologize for the delay and appreciate your patience and continued support.

 Planned Features & Updates

Here are the major features coming in the near future:

Card Pack Vol.9: Omochi Chronicle
New VTuber characters
New Skill&New Battle Type[Chaos Edge].
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247672/4f1215775dce24492541276e576c110bf32d49a2.png
Battle Features

Offline Battle Mode
　Register and send 3v3 team data to simulate matches with others

Lv1 Mode
　A new mode where character skills are disabled—perfect for fair matches between players

Card Fusion System
　Merge unwanted cards to create new powerups or enhancements

Online Battle Mode
　Battle with friends by simply sharing a code!
　Random matchmaking features are also planned.
　⚠️ Note: Original custom characters cannot be used in online battles.

About Card Pack Vol.10

We are also considering the launch of Card Pack Vol.10.
However, before opening applications, we will first focus on strengthening the core gameplay and battle systems.

Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we're working hard to bring you more exciting content.
Thank you again for playing VTBattle – Not About Subscribers, It's About Power!

notes.title: VTBattle - 4th Update Announcement
notes.content:
On March 9, 2025 (Sunday), the 4th card pack "RealitySync" will be released for VTBattle: It's Not About Subscribers! Strength Decides the Winner!, available now on Steam!
With this update, the total number of participating VTubers will increase from 105 to 140! Additionally, players who meet specific conditions can unlock hidden characters!

[Highlights of the 4th Update]
-35 new VTubers join the battle!
-New type "Gambler" added!
-43 brand-new skills introduced!
-New status effects: "Diminish" & "Mana Down"!
-Card HP adjustments for better balance!
-Five new in-game events added!

[About the New Type: "Gambler"]
The Gambler is a new sub-type of the Balanced class that introduces a high-risk, high-reward playstyle.

Normal attacks are slightly weaker, but strong attacks and magic attacks are more powerful compared to other types.
Special moves rely on rolling a dice!
Roll a 1 → Execute a powerful special attack without consuming the gauge!
Roll a 6 → Your HP is cut in half!?
This type challenges players to decide whether to take risks or play it safe in battle!

[A Sneak Peek at New Skills]
Elemental Power Lv1 (U) – When set in slot 1, increases ATK and MAG by 1.1x for cards of the same element.
Pebble Throw (U) – 80% chance to deal a fixed 100 damage.
Dull Blade Lv1 (SR) – 15% chance to inflict Diminish (halves ATK for the next turn).
Mystic Word β (SSR) – 20% chance to inflict Mana Down (halves MAG for the next turn).
New Status Effects
Diminish – ATK is halved until the next turn.
Mana Down – MAG is halved until the next turn.
These new status effects add more depth to battles—use them wisely to gain an advantage!

Thank you for your continued support of VTBattle: It's Not About Subscribers! Strength Decides the Winner!

We hope you enjoy the latest update!

notes.title: Ver1.0.0.8 Update – Optimization and Skill Activation Fixes
notes.content:
・We have released the Ver1.0.0.8 update. Below are the details of the improvements:

Key Improvements
1)Game Optimization
Reduced the loading time when starting the game.
Revised the data processing method, changing from preloading all data at startup to a dynamic loading system that loads data as needed.
As a result, some images may not appear immediately after a screen transition. This adjustment was made to optimize overall game performance.
Further optimization improvements are planned for future updates.
Improved Initial Skill Activation in Battles

2)Skills at the start of a battle now activate one by one in sequence.
Actions such as "Attack," "Type Change," and "Element Change" are now processed step by step to ensure smoother and more stable gameplay.
3)Minor Text Fixes

Several minor text-related corrections have been made.
We experienced a few issues during earlier updates, but this time we believe the game is stable.
If you encounter any problems, please let us know. Thank you for your continued support of "V-Tuber Battle: It’s Not About Subscribers, It’s About Power!"

notes.title: UI Adjustment and Skill Timing Addition
notes.content:
The "Sell" button has been made more prominent than before.
Skill activation timing has been added.
Currently, there are three types of skill activation timing:

1.At the start of the battle: The skill activates when the battle begins and its effect disappears when the battle ends.
2.Added to the card: For status-boosting skills, the effect is already embedded within the card.
3.On the player's action: During the battle, the skill has a chance to activate each time the player takes an action.
